The serum

GHK-Cu + SNAP-8 Face Serum

What's inside

Two peptides, one simple routine.

We keep the formula focused: proven cosmetic peptides in a gentle base, packaged to protect them from light and heat.

Copper tripeptide-1

GHK-Cu

A copper-binding peptide found naturally in skin. Helps skin look smoother, firmer and more resilient.

Acetyl octapeptide-3

SNAP-8

An expression-line peptide that helps soften the look of fine lines around the eyes and forehead.

Formula

Non-comedogenic base

Lightweight and suitable for all skin types. Layers easily under moisturizer and makeup.

Packaging

Amber & airless

An amber, vacuum-sealed airless pump shields the peptides from light and air, the two things that weaken them fastest.

Fresh by design

Four things that set our serum apart.

Peptides are delicate. Light, air, time and heat all weaken them, so we built every step around protecting them.

01

Amber bottle

GHK-Cu is sensitive to light. Our amber bottle filters out the light that breaks peptides down.

02

Airless pump

GHK-Cu's copper–peptide bond is sensitive to oxygen. Standard pumps pull air in every time you dispense. Our vacuum-sealed airless pump pushes serum up from the bottom, so air never gets back inside.

03

Made to order

Your peptides are reconstituted within 24 hours of shipping, so you never have to wonder how long it sat on a shelf.

04

Shipped cold

Packed with cold packs in insulated packaging and delivered chilled, right to your door.
